claim_text: In FY25, total scope 1 operational emissions decreased by 7.1% in absolute emissions, primarily due to investment in the PLS Power Strategy and successful completion of Stage 1, as well as the Ngungaju Plant being placed into care and maintenance from November 2024.
context_text: In FY25, total scope 1 operational emissions decreased by 7.1% in absolute emissions, primarily due to investment in the PLS Power Strategy and successful completion of Stage 1, as well as the Ngungaju Plant being placed into care and maintenance from November 2024.；FY25 (tCO2-e) FY24 (tCO2-e) Scope 1 167,450 180,291 ▼ 7.1%.
label: Fully Supported
rationale_short: 表格给出的Scope 1排放从180,291降至167,450 tCO2-e，正好对应7.1%的绝对降幅，直接支持claim。
notes: claim 自带数据，证据取自同页表格。
llm_reason: The claim’s central assertion is that FY25 total Scope 1 operational emissions decreased by 7.1% in absolute terms versus FY24, and it attributes the decrease primarily to specific actions/events (PLS Power Strategy/Stage 1 completion and Ngungaju Plant care and maintenance from Nov 2024). The provided evidence substantiates the numerical decrease: Scope 1 emissions are shown as 167,450 tCO2-e in FY25 versus 180,291 tCO2-e in FY24, with a stated ▼ 7.1% change. However, the evidence does not provide substantive factual support for the causal attribution (“primarily due to” the listed investments/completion and plant status change) beyond asserting it; no quantified contribution, linkage, or supporting details are provided for those drivers.
